title: Detecting Dataset Bias in Medical AI: A Generalized and Modality-Agnostic Auditing Framework
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and evaluation of G-AUDIT, a framework for detecting statistical shortcuts and biases in medical datasets using information theory and causal inference. Although it addresses 'stigmatizing language'—which is an ethical concern—it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or formal moral/ethical frameworks.
